versions.name: Hanna Venture Base

features.note: The base building is heated and step-free accessible.
Indoor bedrooms sleeping about twenty, with two meeting rooms and a kitchen.

versions.summary: High-adventure base within Samoset Council's Crystal Lake Scout Reservation in Rhinelander, Wisconsin, offering week-long wilderness treks to the Apostle Islands and Porcupine Mountains for older Scouts and Venturers, with gear provided.

sources.citation: Community correction via Camp Finder Suggest-a-Correction form; submitted by the camp director 2026-08-13 (submission M16k0Nl), kept anonymous at submitter request. Director reports the mapped location is wrong: the base is part of Tesomas Scout Camp, at the far end of Hanna Lane, Rhinelander WI. Coordinates cleared pending re-geocoding; this conflicts with the record's Crystal Lake Scout Reservation / Spider Lake Rd placement, so resolve the reservation and street before re-placing.

Resolved 2026-08-14: Crystal Lake Scout Reservation contains Tesomas, Akela's World, and Hanna Venture Base, so the CLSR / Spider Lake Rd placement was correct. Coordinate set to the reservation address (approximate) via the US Census geocoder; elevation from the open-meteo DEM. The exact Hanna base point (far end of Hanna Lane) and July normals are still pending.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
